name: text-diff
title: Text Diff
description: Word-level diff (Myers) that calls out changed numbers (30 → 14) and draws invisible changes like doubled spaces, line breaks and zero-width characters, in inline or split view, and stays fast on long documents with small changes.

meta.stops: Approved an edit I didn't see
meta.summary: Shows a word-level diff that makes changed numbers and invisible whitespace changes visible, so an edit can't slip through unseen.
catches: Changed numbers, kept whole (1,250.50 is one token) and called out
Whitespace, line-break and zero-width character changes, drawn visibly
Counts of words added and removed
limits: Word-level, not semantic: reworded sentences show as remove + add
Very large diffs fall back to a coarser result past the memory budget
a11y: Added and removed runs carry sr-only labels (srAddedLabel/srRemovedLabel)
Invisible characters have a title tooltip
